title: Racksail rule
description: The spec of a core.policy resource: a one-line CEL rule that denies changes or fills in defaults.

type.description: validate rules deny a change with a message; default rules fill or override fields on create.

kinds.description: Kinds the rule applies to; all kinds when empty.

operations.description: Operations the rule applies to: create, update, delete or action names; all when empty.

expression.description: For validate rules, a CEL expression that is true when the change must be refused. Variables: request, resource, oldResource, account, plan, user, server.

message.description: Shown to the person whose change was refused.

defaults.description: For default rules, fields to fill on create.

field.description: Spec path, such as quotaBytes or headers.security.

override.description: Replace a value the request set, not only fill a missing one.
